1_window_above_floor: A plan-cut WINDOW occurrence is never a floor opening by itself. Represent it as a FLOOR_CONTACT classification of the hosting wall span: PLAN_OPENING + VERTICAL EVIDENCE -> WINDOW_ABOVE_FLOOR (wall below: skirting continues) / FULL_HEIGHT_FLOOR_OPENING (path breaks) / FLOOR_CONTACT_UNPROVEN (span withheld). Vertical evidence: a source sill / schedule / section first; else a scoped owner fact. The plan convention (the wall face line drawn continuous across the opening) is corroboration of a sill, never alone the authority.
